#include <iostream>

int main() {
    std::ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);

    int w, m;
    std::cin >> w >> m;

    bool ok = true;
    while (m != 0) {
        int digit = m % w;
        if (digit == 0 || digit == 1) {
            m /= w;
        } else if (digit == w - 1) {
            m = (m + 1) / w;
        } else {
            ok = false;
            break;
        }
    }

    std::cout << (ok ? "YES" : "NO") << std::flush;
    return 0;
}
